quality_rule: Lexicographic: accepted geometry first; number of other views with >=pnp_min_inliers unambiguous seed landmark links descending; minimum 8x6 seed inlier occupancy fraction descending; E inliers descending; canonical pair ascending. No new rejection gate, weights or PnP retries.
quality_ablation: quality_without_graph: same order but omit reachable-other-views term
unknown_rule: missing/nonfinite coverage sorts after measurable coverage, recorded null; rejected geometry retains reason
resource_profile: New bounded Stage7B BA profile, identical for all arms; preserve candidates and fallback on timeout, no points subsampled. Same 800x600 RGB Pillow bilinear / known full skew K / frozen RootSIFT and LightGlue as Stage7A.

metrics.joint_pose_error: max(rotation angle, directed translation angle), all planned camera pairs denominator; unregistered scores zero
metrics.auc: Stage7A linear score mean(max(0,1-error/T)), T=5/10/20; not an unqualified standard empirical CDF AUC
metrics.correct_initialization: seed accepted and joint error <=5 degrees, before BA
metrics.accurate_reconstruction: all input cameras registered and every planned pair joint error <=5 degrees, after BA
metrics.correct_cameras: registered seed anchor plus cameras with anchor-relative joint error <=5; also publish conservative all-incident-pairs correctness
metrics.false_and_severe: accepted pairs error >5 and >20 divided by ALL planned pairs; also conditional on registered pairs
metrics.sparse_quality: observed reprojection/positive depths only; dense or GT point accuracy unavailable
metrics.aggregation: equal conditions within object, equal objects within split; seeds correlated replicates; report tails, worst object, all failures

decision: C requires more accurate scenes or correct cameras or fewer false/severe pairs than B on independent objects, no increase in severe failures, nonnegative object-macro AUC10 delta on every independent object. Otherwise no promotion; no test-driven revision. Retry gains alone engineering only.
independent_source: Official DTU Rectified.zip byte ranges only, exactly scans9/10/11 light3 views1..5/10/20; cal18 matrices from existing SampleSet. No other objects or replacements on failure. Estimated 51.4MB transfer including ZIP index, 44.3MB extracted images; full 129.6GB archive forbidden.
colmap_reference: Existing adapter and configs/methods/colmap_stage3.json unchanged: self-estimated shared PINHOLE, SIFT8192, seed42, CPU8,180s per case. Separate mature reference, not fair known-K/frontend attribution.
freeze: Before Stage7B predictions and new-scene downloads; one predeclared configuration; stop after full matrix and one coverage ablation, retain failures; no threshold search. No commit/push.
preprocessing_correction: Apply GaussianBlur(radius4) to original1600x1200 RGB before Pillow bilinear resize, exactly Stage3 blur5. V1 prepared blurred processed images at radius4, stopped before independent strategy predictions, all failure artifacts retained. Same ranking/thresholds/budget/seeds. No independent metric used to correct preprocessing.
